title: My roguelite is a 100-floor mall that gets less like a mall the deeper you go
author: GTTGgames
selftext:
Also, there's hats and a hot dog gun.   
  
It's still a work in progress but the v1 is out now! [https://glitchthroughtheground.itch.io/the-mall-is-a-dungeon](https://glitchthroughtheground.itch.io/the-mall-is-a-dungeon) 

I actually had shelved the game to work on something else (you know how it is) and then a friend said .. hey I want to play that game you showed me a while ago..what was it? and I was like oh yeah I never released it .. ok i'll put it up. ha

comments.author: Foreign-Quote-53
comments.body: I like that you aren’t using obviously AI generated assets. Gives it some flavor. Still think it’s missing something visually though

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: thanks well I worked on an art style with AI to make a procedural generated art style thats like drawings, and had given it some original stick figure ideas ha. I think I drew. v2 might add some other elements -just unearthing the project for a friend and now people are like playing it ha

replies.author: Foreign-Quote-53
replies.body:
Yeah, I was thinking there was still AI involved, just not the standard, kinda yellowy, generic AI art. Which I think was a good choice.

Anyway, sounds like you’re kinda sorta done with it so aren’t planning to make large changes but. Just an observation, I guess

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: thanks. and def will still update it with patches. one patch can change a game! whats something youd like to see visually? also if you get past the first boss the game starts to add color (spoiler) and visual effects....

comments.author: GTTGgames
comments.body: last build had a bug - fixed and it's back up!

comments.author: AshlaStudios
comments.body: Cool direction, has a nice vibe to it. Needs more polish but definitely see potential in it.

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: hey thanks! yeah it was on the back burner but now that I brought it up to the .. main plate? ha im gonna work on it again. i had a LIST of stuff to do before I temp shelved it
